images.filename: London Charterhouse 26.jpg
images.caption: The Master's Lodge of the London Charterhouse. Pen and ink drawing by Charles Raymond Booth Barrett. "Both the exterior and interior of the Master's Lodge are of interest. Without, the weather-beaten stonework of the gable forms a picturesque view. Within, some of the rooms are noble, and rejoice in notable fireplaces. The 'long gallery,' though curtailed, is yet nearly fifty feet in extent."
images.alt: The Master's Lodge of the London Charterhouse. Pen and ink drawing by Charles Raymond Booth Barrett. "Both the exterior and interior of the Master's Lodge are of interest. Without, the weather-beaten stonework of the gable forms a picturesque view. Within, some of the rooms are noble, and rejoice in notable fireplaces. The 'long gallery,' though curtailed, is yet nearly fifty feet in extent."

images.filename: Charterhouse glimpsed through the trees from Frith Hill, Godalming - geograph.org.uk - 148776.jpg
images.caption: Charterhouse glimpsed through the trees from Frith Hill, Godalming. Charterhouse School moved from Finsbury in 1872 into new buildings by P C Hardwick, in a Gothic style looking quite mysterious through the trees.  In front, there are modern flats along the hillside.  Taken from just off Twycross Road.
images.alt: Charterhouse glimpsed through the trees from Frith Hill, Godalming.
